item.title: Oyo High Court Upholds Validity of PDP's 2025 National Convention in Ibadan

item.title: Nigeria's GDP Grows by 4.07% in Q4 2025 – NBS Reports Acceleration
item.description: Nigeria's gross domestic product (GDP) expanded by 4.07% year-on-year in real terms during the fourth quarter of 2025, according to the latest report from the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS).The NBS released the figures on Friday, February 27, 2026, showing a steady improvement from the 3.76% growth recorded in Q4 2024.
